requirement: Implement SafeTransferManager with account ID-based lock hierarchy to prevent deadlocks, single-lock self-transfer handling, balance validation, and transaction rollback on credit failure.
skeleton: SafeTransferManager and Account classes with deadlock-free lock acquisition.

rationale.teaches: Deadlock-free transfers through a global lock order by account id, a single-lock path for self-transfers, a balance check, and rollback when the credit fails.
rationale.why: Lock-order bugs pass every sequential test and deadlock only under contention. The fixture drives opposing transfers concurrently with a timeout, turning a hang into a red.

candidates.why_wrong: Locks are taken in argument order, so two opposing transfers acquire in opposite order and deadlock.
A self-transfer tries to take the same non-reentrant lock twice and deadlocks.
The balance check is gone, so a transfer can overdraw the source account.
A failing credit leaves the debit in place, so money is destroyed instead of rolled back.
The else branch of the ordering ternary repeats the argument order, so half of all transfer pairs still deadlock.
